name: cure-policy-guard
description: Refuses a tool call that breaks a written Cure house rule unless the person overrides: file writes (no cron in workflows, Vertex-only Gemini in PHI repos, no new AI vendors in minors' repos, no hard-coded credentials, no building another machine's state rows) and Bash/WebFetch requests to consumer AI APIs from PHI or minors' repos. Every override is recorded; /policy-guard lists them.

askTimeoutSeconds.title: Override question timeout (seconds)
askTimeoutSeconds.description: How long the override question waits before the write is refused, so an unattended session or /loop never stalls. 5 to 600.
